description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant situated on the busy Kingsway corridor in Vancouver, serving burgers, chicken, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. The location includes both indoor and outdoor seating areas and a drive-through lane. It sits on a well-travelled urban cycling route connecting Burnaby and Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 28m; stands (3 spaces) at 62m. Total: 7 spaces.
